interpretation.claim_text: Discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed.
interpretation.rationale: The focal passage establishes that discounts above 15% require Finance (Head of Finance & People Ops) approval before the deal is closed. This is supported by the text: "1. Any discount of **15% or greater** off list price on a new-business deal requires written approval from the Head of Finance & People Ops before the deal is marked Closed Won in the CRM." The passage clearly states the condition for approval (15% or greater) and the timing (before the deal is closed).
